title: Settings and accessibility - House of Pips Wiki
description: Every House of Pips settings tab: language, display, sound, animation, accessibility options such as colorblind mode, high contrast and text size, and voice chat.
html:
Settings and accessibility

Open Settings from the main menu or from the menu button during a match. Changes save automatically. Settings has four tabs: General, Motion, Access and Voice. Hover a setting to read what it does.

Use Steam overlay to open Steam while playing. If it cannot open, the notice beside Settings explains what to check and keeps its full heading above the instructions at larger text sizes. Check both Steam's In Game setting and this game's Properties, then restart the game.

General #

  • Language: Auto (follows your Steam language), English, 简体中文, Русский, Español (España), Português (Brasil), Italiano, Español (Latinoamérica), 日本語, Deutsch, Français, Polski, 한국어, 繁體中文, Türkçe, Български, Čeština, Dansk, Nederlands, Suomi, Ελληνικά, Magyar, Bahasa Indonesia, Norsk, Português (Portugal), Română, Svenska or Українська.
  • Display mode: Fullscreen or Windowed.
  • Sound effects and Music volume.
  • Music order: play your selected song or shuffle, plus a Next song button.
  • Anonymous error reports: choose whether the game may send bug reports. The first-launch prompt explains what is included and what is excluded. You can change your answer here at any time.

The wiki uses English catalogue names. In another game language, the rarity, icon and skill-tree tab help you identify the same entry. Changing language keeps your unlocks, perk effects and match rules.

Motion #

  • Draft reveal how perk cards are revealed (Pixel scan, Conjurer's Seal, Bone Cascade, Jackpot Vault or Minimal).
  • Score popups Pixel outline (the default) or Soft shadow lettering for score calls. Your saved choice is kept across updates.
  • Animation speed Cinematic, Quick or Instant.
  • Avatar microphone uses your microphone to animate your portrait outside voice chat. Off by default, and the audio is never saved.
  • Controller rumble on by default. The controller you are playing with rumbles when bones slap down, points score, hands are won and Bone Boxes open. Turning it on gives one short pulse so you can feel it. It works even with sound effects muted, and only the controller in use rumbles.

Access #

  • Menu narration reads the hovered or focused menu control aloud with the Windows voice. Press F1 to switch it on or off anywhere.
  • Colorblind mode swaps to a blue and orange accent palette.
  • High contrast a plain dark background, opaque panels and brighter text and controls.
  • Text size Standard, Large or Extra large. Large lifts small labels and notes to the size of body text; Extra large lifts body text too, sized for a handheld screen such as the Steam Deck's. Screens smaller than 1920×1080, such as the Steam Deck's, and larger screens, such as a docked Steam Deck's TV or a desktop monitor, each keep their own size. Until you pick one for a screen, it starts on the recommended size: Extra large on a smaller screen, Standard on a larger one. Docking or undocking a Steam Deck switches the size straight away, even mid-match. The first time you reach the main menu on a screen without a chosen size, the game asks you once, before the error report prompt on first launch, with the recommended size already selected; each size you try redraws the screen at once.
  • Reduce motion calms screen movement and locks the draft reveal to Minimal.
  • Drag targets Standard or Large drop zones for placing bones.
  • Controller bindings Edit in Steam opens your Steam Input layout.

Every rarity also has its own frame shape, shown in a legend on this tab, so you never need colour alone to tell a Rare card from an Epic one.

Voice #

  • Chat volume for online voice chat.
  • Whether your microphone starts live or muted, and whether your opponent's voice starts heard or muted, at the start of each match.
  • Silence muted voices.
  • Voice style: Natural, Table radio, House phone, Gramophone or Arcade cabinet. Sample plays a synthetic voice. Hear my mic lets you hear your selected microphone through the style while you talk; select Stop listening to end the test. Both previews play only on your device and send nothing to other players. Use headphones to avoid feedback.
  • Speaker and Microphone device pickers.

During a match #

Settings opened from the table also offers Save and exit and Rage quit. See Saving, Continue and Steam Cloud.
